note_en: 起来 after a verb often means "when you actually do it" and introduces an impression: 行书写起来比楷书快 "running script is faster to write than regular script," 看起来比较自然流畅 "it looks fairly natural and fluid." Here 起来 has nothing to do with getting up; it works like English "to write" in "easy to write" or the verb "look" in "it looks smooth."
